Name: Squid-like Squid Kids
Author: TeaLovingLad
Description:
Ever since I found out that those pink floating heads in the mines are called Squid Kids, I have been bothered by the fact that they look
nothing like squids.
This mod addresses my small gripe, maybe even yours, if you have been bothered by this.

[b]This affects both the standard Squid Kids and the dangerous variants.[/b]


[size=5][center]Install[/center][/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]



[center]Thank you for at least considering to download/endorse this mod.

[b]Now go on and have a good one of whatever you feel like![/b][b][/b][/center][b]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[color=#00ffff] ﻿- Tea-Loving Lad[/color][/b]
